name: Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 1 Low OG 'Better With Time'
story_html: The Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 1 Low OG 'Better With Time' takes inspiration from an unreleased AJ1 High that was gifted to the BMX star in 2022. The low-top sports a black tumbled leather upper, featuring abrasions and scuff marks throughout. A woven 'Bike Air' tag graces the Muslin-colored nylon tongue, matching the signature Swoosh and the Wings logo stamped on the back tab. An embroidered mini-Swoosh adorns the lateral forefoot. The sneaker rests on a durable cupsole, highlighted by aged off-white sidewalls and a pre-distressed rubber outsole in Varsity Red.
